candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi conditional adverbs, conjunctions, and relative markers related to time and circumstance.
This feature vector represents common Hindi verb roots and morphological stems.
This feature vector activates common Hindi verbal suffixes and root morphemes indicating tense, aspect, and gender agreement.
This vector activates on common Hindi sub-word tokens and consonant-vowel combinations.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel matras combined with punctuation marks.
These tokens represent common Devanagari script prefixes, suffixes, and character combinations found in Hindi and Sanskrit text tokens.

This feature vector activates on Devanagari character combinations featuring the consonant 'ि' (matra for 'i') alongside various other consonants, often functioning as subword tokens in multilingual text processing.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments of the Devanagari script used in Hindi text.
This vector represents common prefixes, suffixes, and numerical fragments found in Hindi text.
This vector activates for Hindi consonants combined with the vowel sign 'Talaavye' or 'U-matra', representing phonological components of the Devanagari script.
